title: flowguard_record_mutation_evidence
description: Record an observed mutation report as immutable session-state evidence; the implementation digest is bound from session state, never from caller input.

command.description: Exact command that produced the mutation report.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the mutation run started.

completedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the mutation run completed.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the mutation command.

reportPath.description: Repository-relative path to the saved mutation report.
